subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should the fix for this issue be the broader bounded, metadata-rich, actionable-timeout approval flow in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 rather than the older apply-only 300s timeout in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94315?
rationale: The core bug is source-proven, but the timeout contract is an approval security-boundary choice because longer waits, shorter waits, prompt metadata, and timeout outcome semantics affect generated-skill apply approvals.

options.title: Repair And Land The Broader Approval Flow
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical fix after resolving its approval-boundary findings and adding live proof.

options.title: Take The Apply-Only Timeout Increase
options.body: Proceed with the narrower https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94315 shape if maintainers explicitly prefer a longer apply approval window without changing prompt metadata or timeout semantics.

options.title: Pause For Approval API Direction
options.body: Hold both PRs until maintainers choose the permanent lifecycle approval timeout, prompt, and revision-binding contract.

recommendation.title: Repair And Land The Broader Approval Flow
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical fix after resolving its approval-boundary findings and adding live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this issue and owns the broader open closing PR that currently appears to be the canonical repair path.
